preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 50.
Matrix size N is between 4 and 64.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= matrix[i][j] <= N*N for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix are between 1 and N^2.

preconditions.expression: len(set(matrix[i][j] for i in range(N) for j in range(N))) == N*N
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix are unique.

postconditions.expression: all(matrix[i][j] == (i * N + j + 1) for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
postconditions.description: The matrix is sorted in row-major order.
The output is the smallest number of operations required to sort the matrix.
